parsed.production_notes: The top half features an AI-generated humanoid robot with slightly unnatural lip-sync and stiff movements. The bottom half uses various stock ASMR video clips.

characters.appearance: Male humanoid robot. Fair human face with short brown hair on top. Exposed mechanical parts, wires, and metal on the sides and back of the head and neck.
characters.wardrobe: Dark blue collared shirt. Holding a black microphone.

panels.panel_visual_description: A humanoid robot with a human face and mechanical head/neck speaks into a black microphone. He wears a dark blue collared shirt. The background is dark with blurred, warm circular lights.

A hand presses a cylindrical block of beige kinetic sand down through an inverted black wire mesh basket. The sand extrudes through the hexagonal holes of the mesh. The background is a light grey brick wall.

scenes.visual_description: Split screen layout. The top panel shows an AI robot speaking into a microphone. The bottom panel shows satisfying ASMR footage of kinetic sand being pressed through a mesh basket. Dynamic text overlays appear in the center.

Character A says: ஆனா எல்லாரும் எப்பவும் நம்ம கூட பிராக்டிஸ் பண்ண ரெடியா இருக்க மாட்டாங்க. [But not everyone will always be ready to practice with us.]
scenes.on_screen_text: யாரிடமும் பேசாம கண்டிப்பா நல்ல இங்கிலீஷ் பேச முடியாது ஆனா எல்லாரும் எப்பவும் நம்ம கூட பிராக்டிஸ் பண்ண ரெடியா இருக்க மாட்டாங்க (Without speaking to anyone, you definitely cannot speak good English. But not everyone will always be ready to practice with us.)
